name: Gnomes Win!
label: Quest
description: In Thousand Needles, a gnome race ticket pays off when the gnomes come out ahead. A prize box comes back to whoever held the winning stub.
intro: In Thousand Needles, a gnome race ticket pays off when the gnomes come out ahead. A prize box comes back to whoever held the winning stub.

p: The gnome race ticket is the stub that counts when the gnomes win. Hold on to it, and a gnome prize box is yours once the result is in. The goblin ticket has a result of its own, for the other side of the race.
